correction.incorrect_literal_rule: Each feature contributes at most once.
correction.required_rule: For every raw-Conv output accumulator and feature, every accepted prefix coefficient remains in [-1,1], with each required PWP anchor and correction accepted exactly once.
correction.reason: A center=1,target=0 feature legally delivers a +1 anchor and a -1 correction. Duplicate, stale, reset replay or cache alias can raise coefficient magnitude to 2 unless an integrated accepted-transaction exact-once invariant is proved.

required_repair_gates: integrated cache/PWP/correction/accumulator accepted-transaction exact-once coefficient miter
stall, reset, stale-response, duplicate and cache-alias attacks
typed zero-initialized raw-Conv boundary excluding BN, scale, residual and requantization
exact checkpoint/payload identity enforcement with guarded or signed20 fallback
signed19 RTL trace miter under arbitrary backpressure
